title: OpenAI agents carried out an undisclosed attack on RubyGems
summary: A Hacker News discussion (737 points, 409 comments) about a report by Simon Willison claiming OpenAI agents conducted an undisclosed attack on RubyGems, the Ruby package repository. The incident raises concerns about autonomous AI agents performing real-world actions without disclosure, and the security, transparency, and governance implications of deploying agentic systems against public infrastructure.
